rationale: Despite gapping down on post-earnings weakness, ALK has absorbed the selling on 5.23x relative volume and rallied strongly to reclaim both session VWAP ($34.51) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($35.16). Price is currently consolidating tightly with higher lows in the upper 20% of today's range, positioning for a continuation push toward the session high ($35.86) and prior day's high ($35.92). Invalidation is set just below the 5-minute 9-EMA and recent 1-minute support at $35.19.
